LTD. | MOTOR VEHICLE PARTS USED IN AUTOMOBILESSUCH AS TRUCKS, BUSES ETC - REAR AXLE BRAKE ASSEMBLY UNIT MOUNT CAMS PART NO MPS- | CHENNAI SEA INMAA1, India | Singapore | 84839000 | 1116127". Other visible lines same date/destination: HS 73201011 (return spring kit), 73182200 (cam shaft washer kit), 73181600 (thru shaft mtg kit), 84824000 (brg cup cone), B/L 1116127 and 1118372. Buyer-side lanes shown: TMBP LIMITED (Laem Chabang, Thailand) 1251 port count, MERITOR HVS CAMERI S.P.A (Genoa, Italy) 428, UDTRUCKS SINGAPORE 183. Note: declared HS 871690 (trailer parts) does not match the observed export lines (HS 73xx/84xx motor-vehicle parts); per project rule this is not a rejection ground — actual HS is 73201011/73182200/73181600/84824000/84839000, verdict accepted_hs_corrected.
domestic_evidence: Screener.in company page (https://www.screener.in/company/AUTOAXLES/consolidated/) — listed BSE: 505010 / NSE: AUTOAXLES; exact line quoted: "Sales + 584 541 572 492 495 531 560 489 462 562 664 517 663" (quarterly sales in Rs crore, Sep 2023 – Sep 2026) and annual P&L "Mar 2026 (S) ... Sales 2,178". Company description: "manufacturing and supplying Automotive Parts to the major domestic and global manufacturers of Trucks & Buses (LCV, MCV, HCV, Military & Off-highway Vehicle Segment)". Domestic supply is thus evidenced by audited/reported revenue of Rs 2,178 crore (FY2026) and Rs 2,078 crore (FY2025) to Indian OEMs; GSTIN-level turnover band and GeM/CPPP tender records were not retrieved (search tool returned connection errors), so those specifics are null.
note: Real shipments confirmed, not merely declared: dated customs export lines to Singapore (UD Trucks Singapore) on 2026-02-28 with B/L numbers 1116127 and 1118372, plus recurring lanes to Thailand (TMBP Ltd, Laem Chabang) and Italy (Meritor HVS Cameri, Genoa). Domestic supply confirmed by reported annual turnover of Rs 2,178 crore (FY2026) and Rs 2,078 crore (FY2025) as an OEM axle/brake supplier to Indian truck and bus makers. Source counter vs rows seen: ImportKey claims 6,454 shipments / 50 partners; only 5 rows were visible in the free view — the remaining volume is behind a paywall and was not verified line by line. Declared HS 871690 is inconsistent with observed export HS codes (73201011, 73182200, 73181600, 84824000, 84839000); HS corrected, company retained (accepted_hs_corrected), not rejected. No sanctions/court/ownership issues assessed here (out of scope for this role). GSTIN and PAN not public in retrieved sources — null.
